title: GET /api/p/:pid/elements
description: The elements of memory search (with ?archived=true also the archived ones), each with its local-changes marker and action descriptor (spec-004 §3, spec-003 §8). Without a readable memory.yaml, no descriptor and typesError says why (spec-004 §5).

missingReferences.description: The missing-reference filter (spec-012 §5): shown when taxonomy.requires names a type; the elements whose file could not be read and those indexed incompletely. Absent with typesError.

shortId.description: The element's short id (spec-011 §1): the literal prefix of its type's id_pattern before {n} plus the digits of the full id; absent when the element has none.

missingCategories.description: The categories taxonomy.requires names for the element's type that it carries no reference of, in requires order (spec-012 §5); absent when none is missing, the file unreadable or the type without requires.

row.description: One element of the list (spec-004 §3): its memory search match, marker, short id, descriptor and missing-reference flag; also the element rows of Traceability (spec-012 §4).
